en: Black-and-white photograph showing a group of well‑dressed men and women, many wearing suits, hats, and summer dresses, standing on the deck of a boat. They look toward a lakeshore town in the distance. On the far shore, slightly left of center, rises a prominent church or monastery complex with a tall tower and dome above clustered buildings, surrounded by trees. The lake is calm and stretches across the foreground under a clear sky. There is a small handwritten mark or number in the upper left corner, but no printed caption is visible.
